channel.title: Pier & Point · Rich Sorro Commons
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Rich Sorro Commons (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Rich Sorro Commons: Rich Sorro Commons now uses its Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Rich Sorro Commons now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8706264 and 8706003.

item.title: Correction · Rich Sorro Commons: The map notes for Rich Sorro Commons said 101 units, 174,100 square feet, a supportive housing building and a Head Start centre at 152 Berry St. Mission Housing's project page and the DBI permit both say 100 units; the page gives 158,000 square feet, serves families and people with AIDS/HIV, and mentions only 'a childcare center'. A dated correction was recorded, and the summary already said 100 units. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording.
item.description: The map notes for Rich Sorro Commons said 101 units, 174,100 square feet, a supportive housing building and a Head Start centre at 152 Berry St. Mission Housing's project page and the DBI permit both say 100 units; the page gives 158,000 square feet, serves families and people with AIDS/HIV, and mentions only 'a childcare center'. A dated correction was recorded, and the summary already said 100 units. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording. Source: Mission Housing Development Corporation, Rich Sorro Commons (https://www.missionhousing.org/richsorro); DataSF Building Permits, permit 200004187592 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200004187592); Wikimedia Commons, file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg); Wikimedia Commons, User:Firstcultural (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Firstcultural).
